(2) Where an offence under this section is
committed, then every person who at the time
of the commission of the offence was a director
or an officer of such company shall be deemed
to  have  committed  that  offence  unless  such
person proves that the offence was committed
without such person’s knowledge, or that such
person exercised all due diligence to prevent
the commission of such offence.
(3) A shareholder, secretary, or authorised
person who contravenes or fails to comply with
the provisions under subsection (2) of section
130A or subsection (3) of section 130A or 130C
respectively shall be guilty of an offence and
be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding
one million rupees or to imprisonment of either
description for a period not exceeding ten years
or to both such fine and imprisonment.
